Two surfaces on one brand. The dark set is the marketing site at wandb.ai/site, which loads dark. The light set is the CoreWeave Forge login and signup screens, which force light. Pick the theme that matches the screen you are drawing; do not mix them. Values come from tokens.json; the readings behind them are in raw/.

Colour

The active theme's colour roles, painted from their custom properties so an alias shows its resolved value. Roles marked not captured exist only so both sets have the same keys; the other theme holds the reading.

Core palette

Type

Serif display on the marketing page, sans for everything else. Each specimen is set with its typography token.

Components

Drawn from the component and colour tokens. components.md describes each one and the states that were and were not read.
